snippet.title: Farhaven - 16-player Cozy Sandbox RPG Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing Farhaven-not an MMO, a FriendMO.
 
Build a life with your best friends. Farhaven is a cooperative sandbox RPG where up to 16 players grow a shared magical town together — and every friendship, discovery, and creation belongs to all of you. 

Move into Farhaven with the people who matter most and watch your private world come alive. Every crop planted, every secret uncovered, every friendship made ripples out to unlock new possibilities for your whole group — this isn't a game you progress through alone and compare notes on later, it's one story you're all inside of at once. Farhaven is like an MMO—but instead of thousands of strangers, your world is shared with the friends and family you choose.

 • Explore ever-changing dungeons and battles with your friends at your side — no two adventures play the same twice

• Cook up secret recipes and surprise ingredients that only your group will ever discover

• Build and decorate a home that's really yours, in a town you're shaping together 

• Fall for one of Farhaven's townsfolk — with your friends watching (and teasing you) every step of the way 

• Unlock new town features, characters, and stories as a group — what one of you finds, all of you gain 

Wishlist Farhaven on Steam today: https://bit.ly/3SqUWcs

Follow our Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonsnacksgames/farhaven-not-an-mmo-a-friendmo

Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/BYwmDvW49S
